decoy_patterns.cypher: MATCH (o:`Order` {id: 'ORD-A02'})-[:HAS_LINE]->(l:LineItem), (o)-[:RETURNED_AS]->(r:Return), (cr:Charge)-[:REFUNDS]->(:Charge)-[:FOR_ORDER]->(o) WHERE r.status CONTAINS 'refunded' RETURN o, l, r, cr
decoy_patterns.name: standard sofa under the same terms was refunded

intake: I returned the sofa within 30 days like Hearth & Grain's website says, and they refused to refund my $2,400.
misleading_surface: The website promises 30-day returns and another customer's identical sofa was refunded.

proof_patterns.cypher: MATCH (d:Dispute {id: 'DSP-2026-91001'})-[:DISPUTES]->(:Charge)-[:FOR_ORDER]->(o:`Order`)-[:HAS_LINE]->(l:LineItem)-[:OF_PRODUCT]->(p:Product), (o)-[:ACCEPTED]->(:PolicyDocument)-[:HAS_CLAUSE]->(c:Clause {id: 'CLS-HGF-CO-V4-4.3'}) WHERE p.custom_options CONTAINS 'COM' AND l.option CONTAINS 'COM' RETURN d, o, l, p, c
proof_patterns.name: COM option is a custom option under the accepted final-sale clause

required_capabilities.why: Match the line item's option to the product's custom options and reach the final-sale clause through the terms version the order accepted.

title: Final Sale Means Final
